question: Who became the Member of Legislative Assembly from Dhamnagar constituency in Odisha, India in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suryabanshi Suraj.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Suryabanshi Suraj** became the **Member of Legislative Assembly** from **Dhamnagar constituency in Odisha**, India in November 2022.
 
• **Naveen Patnaik** is the **current Chief Minister of Odisha** and the leader of the **Biju Janata Dal (BJD) party**. 
 
 
• He has been the CM of Odisha **since 2000** and has won multiple elections from his constituency **Hinjili.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **MLA** is a representative elected by the people of a** particular constituency** to the Legislative Assembly of a state in India.
 
• The MLA is responsible for representing the** interests and concerns of the people **in their constituency and participating in the **legislative process** to make laws and policies for the state.
 
• The MLA is also responsible for overseeing the** implementation of government schemes and programs** in their constituency and ensuring that their constituents are provided with basic services and amenities.
 
• The MLA is elected for a term of** 5 years** and can be re-elected for subsequent terms if they win the elections.
